e01.saheli: घणी अच्छी बात सै। अपणा ध्यान रखियो।
e01.text: आज सबेरे Vitamin B12 ले ली।

e02.saheli: बीपी तो बिल्कुल ठीक सै, निश्चिंत रहो।

e03.saheli: कोई बात कोन्या, इब याद आई तो डाक्टर की सलाह मुजब देख ल्यो या अगली खुराक बगत पै ले लियो।

e04.saheli: यो तो घणा बढ़िया फैसला सै। सांझ की सैर सेहत खातर बहुत अच्छी रहवैगी।
e04.text: काल्ल तै रोज सांझ नै 6:30 बजे सैर पै जाणा सै।

e05.saheli: हांजी, त्योहार की रौनक अलगै होवै सै। खूब मौज-मस्ती करियो।

h001.saheli: Noted clearly, Sumit! I have saved all medicine timings and details for your mother.
h001.text:
Hi Saheli! 🙏 Setting up details for mummy रामेश्वर. No medical conditions or allergies. Doctor visit not fixed yet. Medicines:
- Vitamin B12 1500 mcg at 08:00
- Rosuvastatin 10 mg at 21:30
- Iron 100 mg at 13:00
- Domperidone 10 mg at 08:15
- Folic acid 5 mg at 08:00
- Multivitamin half tablet (1 tablet) at 13:00 👍

h002.saheli: That sounds wonderfully comforting! Enjoy your warm meal.
h002.text: Cooked some nice dal tadka and jeera rice today 🍲😋 Smells delicious!

h003.saheli: त्योहार की तैयारियाँ बढ़िया सै, बस आराम तै काम करियो।
h003.text: त्योहार आ लिया, घर लिपाई करनी सै।

h004.saheli: घणी अच्छी बात सै, धूप म्हारै बदन खातर भी बढ़िया रहवै।

h005.saheli: बालकां की रौनक़ तै घर म्हारै खिल उठै सै!

h006.saheli: Thanks for updating, Sumit. Just keep in mind Rosuvastatin is scheduled for nighttime (21:30).
h006.text: Mummy took her Rosuvastatin after breakfast today 💊✨

h007.saheli: I'm sorry you are feeling low today, Sumit. Please take it gentle and give yourself some quiet time.
h007.text: Feeling quite low today... 😔 Just one of those days 🌧️

h008.saheli: मेले की सैर खूब बढ़िया रहवैगी, मन खुश हो ज्यागा।

h009.saheli: Got it, Sumit. Thanks for sharing the update!

h010.saheli: That is such a lovely lifelong friendship to cherish every Sunday! 💕
h010.text: Mummy's school bestie Rajbala calls her every Sunday without fail! ☎️❤️ So sweet to see their bond.

h011.saheli: Get some good restful sleep tonight, Sumit. Take care.
h011.text: Super exhausted tonight 🥱 Exhausting day at work 😴

h012.saheli: Sending you warm thoughts, Sumit. Be kind to yourself this evening.
h012.text: Just feeling a bit heavy and low again today 😞💭

h013.saheli: घाम म्हारै ज्यादा लागै तो छांव म्बैठियो अर पानी पीते रहियो।

h014.saheli: Wonderful to hear that! A good night's sleep makes all the difference.
h014.text: Had such a refreshing, sound sleep last night! 😴✨ Feeling so fresh today ☀️

h015.saheli: ठीक सै जी, दवाई लेण की बात ध्यान म्आगी।

h016.saheli: Noted, Sumit! Thank you for keeping track.

h017.saheli: Do wind down early and rest well tonight, Sumit.
h017.text: Completely drained out today 😓 Need rest 🛏️

h018.saheli: Festivals bring such joy and brightness to the family! Enjoy the spirit.
h018.text: Festival vibes starting soon! 🎉 Excitement at home is building up 🪔✨

h019.saheli: दवाई ले ली घणी अच्छी बात सै, याद राखियो यो संझा 21:30 खातर सै।

h020.saheli: घणी बढ़िया बात सै जी, जरूरत पै चाबी पास रहणा काम आवै सै।
h020.text: पड़ोस आली संतोष चाची पै घर की दूसरी चाबी रहवै सै।

h021.saheli: There is no doctor visit scheduled yet on record, Sumit.
h021.text: Saheli, when is mummy's next doctor visit? 🗓️🤔

h022.saheli: वाह जी वाह, देसी घी का चूरमा तो घणा स्वाद लागै सै!

h023.saheli: काम छोड़ कै थोड़ी देर आराम कर ल्यो जी, सुस्ताणा जरूरी सै।

h024.saheli: Children laughing and playing fills the house with pure joy!
h024.text: Kids are having fun playing in the verandah 🏃‍♂️🏏 So much laughter! 😄

h025.saheli: A doctor visit isn't booked yet in our notes, Sumit.
h025.text: When is mummy's next doctor appointment due? 🩺🗓️

h026.saheli: Such precious moments together! Nothing beats time with grandparents.
h026.text: The grandchildren are showing mummy their drawing homework right now 🎨👧👦 Heartwarming!

h027.saheli: Thanks for the update, Sumit. Duly noted!
h027.text: Mummy took Vitamin B12 after breakfast today 💊🥛

h028.saheli: यो सुण कै मन घणा दुखी होया जी, भगवान भाई साहब की आत्मा नै शांति देवै अर थामनै हिम्मत बख्शै।

h029.saheli: It is always a blessing when family gathers together. Glad you had a heartwarming day!
h029.text: Such a pleasant day today! 😊 Family visited us and we all spent quality time together 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦❤️

h030.saheli: Rosuvastatin 10 mg is scheduled for 21:30 tonight.
h030.text: Saheli, what medicines are due for mummy this evening? 💊⏰

h031.saheli: घणा प्यारा नाम सै, Snowy घर मैं खूब लाड लडावै सै के?
h031.text: म्हारी बिल्ली का नाम Snowy सै।

h032.saheli: थारा दुख समझ सकूं, मन भारी होवै सै। थोड़ा थोड़ा खा लिया करो अर जी हलका राख्या करो।
h032.text: छोटा भाई जाण के बाद मन कोन्या लागदा। रोटी भी ना खाई जांदी, घणी उदास रहूँ।

h033.saheli: Good evening Sumit! Please check her prescription chart for the scheduled evening doses with dinner.
h033.text: Hello Saheli! 😊 Can you please tell me what medicines are due for Mom this evening? 💊✨

h034.saheli: घणी आच्छी बात सै, आराम हो गया तो दिन भी बढ़िया बीतेगा।

h035.saheli: बढ़िया करा, दवाई बखत पै ले ली।
h035.text: रोटी खा कै Vitamin B12 ले ली।

h036.saheli: It is always best to take medicines with plain water, Sumit, as tea can interfere with absorption. 💧
h036.text: Hi Saheli! ☕ Can Mom take her medicine with hot tea? 🤔 Just wondering!

h037.saheli: Water is much safer for washing down tablets, Sumit, so please avoid giving them with tea.
h037.text: Quick question Saheli! ☕💊 Is it okay if she takes her tablet along with morning tea? 🙏

h038.saheli: बालकां तैं घर मैं रौनक रहवै सै, खूब खिलवाओ उननै।

h039.saheli: सांझ नै डाक्टर आली परची देख कै रोटी पाछै दवाई ले लियो।

h040.saheli: बालकां की मीठी बातां तैं मन राजी हो ज्या सै।
h040.text: बालक आज स्कूल तैं आ कै घणी बातां करैं थे।

h041.saheli: रफी साहब के गाणे सुनकै मन नै घणा सकून मिलै सै।
h041.text: सांझ नै Mohammed Rafi के पुराणे गाणे सुणूं, घणे पसंद सैं।

h042.saheli: Water is always recommended with medicines, Sumit, as tea can reduce how well they work.
h042.text: Hey Saheli! ☕💊 Just checking, can she take her tablets with milk tea? 🤔

h043.saheli: Please check her clinic slip or hospital card for the exact date of her next consultation, Sumit. 📋
h043.text: Hi Saheli! 🗓️🩺 Do you know when Mom's next doctor visit is scheduled? 🚗

h044.saheli: Festival preparations always bring such wonderful excitement and festive energy home! 🪔
h044.text: Festival season is right around the corner! 🪔✨ Getting the whole house cleaned and ready! 🧹🎉

h045.saheli: थोड़ा आराम कर ल्यो, ढलदी धूप मैं सुस्ताणा जरूरी सै।

h046.saheli: Good to know she took it on time, Sumit! 😊
h046.text: Mom took her Rosuvastatin after breakfast today! 💊🥞👍

h047.saheli: Kindly refer to the appointment slip from the clinic or hospital file to confirm the date, Sumit.
h047.text: Saheli, could you remind me when our next doctor appointment is? 🏥👨‍⚕️📅

h048.saheli: That sounds absolutely delicious, Sumit, enjoy the hearty meal! 🍲
h048.text: Cooking some special dal makhani and hot rotis today! 🍲🫓 Smells heavenly! 😋👨‍🍳

h049.saheli: बालकां गेल खेलण तैं थकान दूर हो ज्या सै।

h050.saheli: घणी प्यारी बात सै, पोती तैं रोज नई बातां सुणया करो।
h050.text: पोती आज नई कविता सुणावै थी।

h051.saheli: थारी परची मैं लिखी सांझ की दवाई रोटी खा कै ले लियो।
h051.text: सांझ की कुणसी दवाई लेणी सै?

h052.saheli: Family visits bring so much warmth and happiness, glad you all had a lovely day! ✨
h052.text: Relatives visited today and had such a happy family time together! 🏡🥰❤️

h053.saheli: Take it easy tonight, Sumit, and get some gentle rest. Tomorrow will be brighter. 🌸
h053.text: Feeling a bit low today Saheli... 😔🌧️ Just one of those tiring days. 💭

h054.saheli: That is wonderful, planning early for Monika's special day will make it memorable! 🎉
h054.text: Monika's birthday is on 21 January! 🎂👧 Already planning what surprise gift to give her! 🎁🎈

h055.saheli: Noted, thank you for making sure she stays on schedule, Sumit! 👍
h055.text: Mom has taken Rosuvastatin after breakfast this morning! 💊🥣✅

h056.saheli: Sending you warm thoughts, Sumit; please relax and sleep early tonight. 🌼
h056.text: Feeling quite low and overwhelmed this evening... 😞💤 Hope tomorrow is better. 🥀

h057.saheli: घणी आच्छी बात सै, बखत पै दवाई लेणा जरूरी सै।
h057.text: रोटी खा कै Iron ले ली।

h058.saheli: Festive planning is always so joyful, hope everyone has a wonderful celebration ahead! 🪔
h058.text: The festival is almost here! 🪔✨ Planning sweets and decorations for the family! 🍬🌸🎉

h059.saheli: बढ़िया करा, तनै दवाई बखत सिर ले ली।
h059.text: रोटी खा कै Folic acid ले ली।

h060.saheli: Great to hear she took it timely after her meal, Sumit! Have a pleasant day. ✨
h060.text: Morning update! 🌞 Mom had her Vitamin B12 after breakfast today. 💊🥣👌

h061.saheli: It sounds like lovely weather to unwind. Enjoy the cool evening breeze!
h061.text: Weather has suddenly become so pleasant tonight! 🌧️☕ Really enjoying the cool breeze outside. 🍃

h062.saheli: थोड़ा आराम कर ल्यो। सेहत का ध्यान राखो।

h063.saheli: त्योहार की तो न्यारी ए रौनक होवै सै! घर में खूब चहल-पहल रहवैगी।

h064.saheli: बहुत बढ़िया, दवाई बख्त पै ले ली।
h064.text: कलेवे पाछै Vitamin B12 ले ली।

h065.saheli: त्योहार की त्यारी में मजा भी खूब आवै सै! बस अपणा ध्यान राखियो।

h066.saheli: It is generally best to take medicines with plain water, as tea can interfere with absorption. You can check with the doctor or pharmacist for this specific medicine.

h067.saheli: शाबाश, दवाई बख्त पै लेण की आदत घणी अच्छी सै।

h068.saheli: बहुत आच्छी बात सै, दवाई टाइम पै ले ली।

h069.saheli: सुण कै घणा अच्छा लाग्या! अच्छी नींद तै दिन बढ़िया बितैगा।

h070.saheli: घणी अच्छी बात सै, याद तै दवाई ले ली।
h070.text: कलेवे पाछै Folic acid ले ली थी।

h071.saheli: Hope it cools down soon and you get some rain! Make sure to stay hydrated.
h071.text: Such a hot and humid evening today! ☀️🥵 Really hoping for some evening showers soon. 🌧️🙏

h072.saheli: सारे जणे इकट्ठे होज्याँ तो मन राजी हो ही जावै सै! बड़ी खुशी की बात सै।
h072.text: कुणबा आया था, मन खुश हो ग्या।

h073.saheli: बाजरे की ताती रोटी तै घणी सुथरी लागै सै! मजे तै खाओ।

h074.saheli: सांझ नै थारी कोई दवाई बाकी कोन्या। आराम तै रहियो।
h074.text: सांझ नै के दवाई लेणी सै?

h075.saheli: धूप तै बच कै छांव में रहियो और पाणी पीते रहियो।

h076.saheli: आज सांझ खातर कोई दवाई तय कोन्या। निश्चिंत रहियो।
h076.text: आज सांझ नै के दवाई लेणी सै?
